items.label: 1-rules.md
items.body:
DROIDEX App is the desktop app on origin/main (1.6.1): src/lib/themeTokens.ts for colour, tailwind.config.js for type and size, packages/icons for glyphs, src/components/ui and transcript/ for the parts. Dark is the default, light is paper.

1. Tokens only: --ds-* values or Tailwind steps equal to them. No hex, no 13.5px.
2. Type through the classes (ds-display … ds-overline, ds-code); each sets size, leading, tracking and weight.
3. 400 to read, 500 to click or label, 600 for headings and unread titles.
4. Space and tone, not lines: no outlines on cards, fields, menus or dialogs, no dividers between rows. Only floating layers cast a shadow.
5. Colour is a signal: status, links, diffs, skills, the brand. Chrome is monochrome.
6. One primary action per surface, and it is the text colour (bg-text text-bg), not a hue.
7. Radius grows with size: 6 chips and tabs, 8 controls and rows, 12 panels and menus, 16 composer, cards and bubbles, 24 dialogs.
8. Every state: rest, hover, pressed, focus, disabled, plus loading, empty and error.
9. Nothing jumps: reserve boxes (caret, time column, spinner), tabular figures.
10. Keyboard first: focus ring for the keyboard only, Escape backs out.

On the canvas: compose primitives, never restyle a raw button. Icons come from the kit's Icon (the DROIDEX set), never emoji.
items.author: user

items.label: 2-feel.md
items.body:
Calm, quick, certain. The agent's work is the loudest thing on screen, and it is written, not boxed.
- A tool call is a sentence ("Read src/lib/diff.ts"), not a card. Bodies open under it on request.
- Hierarchy comes from the four text tones (primary, secondary, muted, quiet), weight and the surface ramp.
- Same cues in both themes; light steps further in tone and leans on shadow.
- Tight inside a group (6–10px), 16px between transcript items.
- Native, not webby: chrome text is not selectable, menus blink on select.

Cues: live work shimmers (Reading…, Working 12s…); a chat that needs you shows the warning clock; a reply waiting shows the half ring; unread titles go 600 and primary; the active row takes the active fill; copied swaps to a check for 1.2s.
items.author: user

items.label: 3-interaction.md
items.body:
- Hover: one rung up the ramp (none → elevated → active), text one tone up, only under @media (hover: hover).
- Pressed: buttons scale to 0.97 for 75ms. Toggles take the active fill.
- Focus: a 1.5px --ds-focus outline on :focus-visible. Menu items show focus as a fill.
- Disabled: 40% and not-allowed, with a tooltip saying why.
- Invalid: danger-soft fill and a caption with the fix.
- Hidden affordances keep their box: the caret, the row's … button and the tab's close appear on hover or focus without moving anything.

Motion (--ds-ease is the app's smooth-out, 0.22 1 0.36 1): hover 150ms; menus 150ms rising 4px, close 100ms fade; dialogs 180ms from 0.96; Expand opens grid rows 0fr → 1fr in 240ms while the content settles 6px in 200ms; the caret turns 90°; cues fade in 160ms. Spinners turn at 1.8s. Reduced motion means none.
items.author: user

items.label: 4-layout.md
items.body:
The window: a 280px sidebar on --ds-sidebar, then the main canvas. Both start with a 36px titlebar strip; the header tabs live in the main one.

The ruler test: lists sit in an 8px gutter (px-2) and rows pad 12px, so icons, titles and headings land on the 20px content edge. Row icons take a 16px slot and a 10px gap (labels at 46px); the session row's status slot is 14px. Trailing meta: a 32px right-aligned time column, then the 14px harness mark, ending 20px from the edge.

Transcript: a 672px column (max-w-2xl) inside 24px padding, 16px between items, steps of a turn 10px apart. Tool bodies indent 20px under their line. The user bubble takes at most 80% and hugs the right edge. The composer is a 16px-radius elevated field; its toolbar sits under it, 10px in, model controls pushed right.

Heights on the 4px grid: 20 badge, 28 small control and tab, 32 control and send, 36 field and titlebar, 52 composer row.
items.author: user

items.label: 5-copy.md
items.body: Sentence case. Verbs for actions ("Create pull request"), past tense for finished work ("Edited 3 files · 5 edits", "Worked for 1m 12s"), the -ing form only while live. Name things the way the app does: chat, workspace, worktree, autonomy (Supervised, Auto-accept edits, Auto, Full access). Errors say what happened and what to do. Times are short (4m, 1h, 2d). No exclamation marks, no emoji.
items.author: user

items.label: 6-engineering.md
items.body:
Build with the kit, as the app does with src/components/ui:
- Icon: <Icon name="git-branch" />, 16px by default, 14 beside small text; aria-hidden unless labelled. Button, Row, MenuItem and Input take an icon name directly. Caret, ArrowUp and Square stay lucide, as in the app.
- Icon-only buttons need aria-label. Rows without onClick are readouts, not buttons.
- Tool bodies, thinking and diffs open through Expand; children stay mounted.
- Status uses StatusGlyph or a Badge with a word; colour never carries state alone.
- Model and harness marks come from ModelIcon (factory, anthropic, claude, openai, google), never a letter in a square.
- Prefer tokens in classes: bg-[color:var(--ds-elevated)]. Use the ds-text-* tone helpers for text.
items.author: user

items.label: 7-checklist.md
items.body: Before you ship a screen: text on the 20px edge; one primary; every control has hover, focus and disabled; live states shimmer and stop; numbers tabular; icons from the DROIDEX set at 16/14; no borders where tone would do; works in light; Escape closes what opened.
items.author: user

items.label: brand.md
items.body: BrandMark is the Silkscreen wordmark, DROIDE + X at -0.04em, coloured by its caller (13px in the sidebar). AppIcon is the DX tile from assets/brand, ink or paper, with the orange X. Never redraw or recolour either.
items.author: user

tokens.note: Window canvas and the reading area

tokens.name: --ds-border
tokens.note: Data-table rows and meaningful lines only

tokens.name: --ds-border-strong

tokens.name: --ds-positive
tokens.note: Success text, icons and confirm actions

tokens.name: --ds-warning
tokens.note: Needs you: waiting for input, limits.

tokens.name: --ds-lift
tokens.note: Translucent hover over a fill that is not on the ramp, such

tokens.name: --ds-press
tokens.note: Translucent press over a non-ramp fill.

tokens.name: --ds-skill
tokens.note: Skill labels in the composer and transcript

tokens.name: --ds-skill-mark
tokens.note: The rosette beside a skill label.

tokens.name: --ds-update
tokens.note: The update pill, the one solid blue fill outside design work

tokens.name: --ds-selection
tokens.note: Design-board selection outline and size badge

tokens.name: --ds-brand-ink
tokens.note: The D on the paper tile and the dark tile itself

tokens.name: --ds-brand-paper
tokens.note: The cream tile and the D on the ink tile

items.label: colour.md
items.body: Values are what deriveThemeTokens produces for the default Droid preset. Surfaces ramp canvas → surface/sidebar → elevated (hover, fields, composer, bubbles) → active (selected). Raised carries menus and dialogs. Text has four tones: fg, secondary (6.2:1), muted (AA) and quiet, which recedes for thinking and folded work. Status colours are fixed hues tuned per scheme; their soft fills are 12% (dark) or 8% (light). Diff, code and mark colours are their own families and never tint chrome.
items.author: user

tokens.name: --ds-text-md
tokens.note: prose, body-lg; the app base size

tokens.name: --ds-font-sans
tokens.note: The platform face, as in the app.

tokens.name: --ds-font-mono
tokens.value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "JetBrains Mono", monospace

items.label: type.md
items.body: The UI uses the system face (SF Pro on macOS) for everything, headings included; code uses the native mono stack. Scale: display 24/30, title 22/28, heading 18/22, subheading 16/20 (600, tracked tighter as they grow); prose 14/22 for replies, body-lg 14/20, body 13/18 for UI, label 12/16 500, caption 11/16, overline 10/12 uppercase; code 12 at 1.5, code-sm 11/16.
items.author: user

items.label: spacing.md
items.body: A 4px grid with 2, 6, 10 and 14 for inside controls. 6 between icon and label in buttons and chips, 8 in menus, 10 in rows.
items.author: user

items.label: radius.md
items.body: xs 4 (kbd, bubble tail), sm 6, md 8 (controls, rows, tabs), lg 12 (tool panels, menus, toasts), xl 16 (composer, cards, bubbles), 2xl 24 (dialogs), full for chips, badges and the send button.
items.author: user

tokens.name: --ds-shadow-md
tokens.note: Floating cards, menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs

items.label: shadows.md
items.body: Two shadows, both with a faint 1px ring that replaces a border: sm for small floating chips, md for menus, dialogs and toasts. Things on the page never cast one.
items.author: user

tokens.name: --ds-ease
tokens.note: smooth out, for anything that moves or opens

items.label: icons.md
items.body: All 167 glyphs of packages/icons, drawn on a 24px grid with a 1.5 stroke and round caps (the spinner is 2). Pick by name: the set's own names, such as square-pen, git-pull-request, square-terminal, supervised, auto-approve, models.
items.author: user

items.label: button.md
items.body: ui/Button. Primary is the text colour; secondary the elevated fill; ghost text-only until hover; danger and success soft fills that go solid on hover. sm 28, md 32, lg 36; min width 64. loading swaps the icon for the spinner and keeps the width.
items.author: user

items.label: badge.md
items.body: 20px pill, caption 500, always a word. Neutral for Interrupted, danger for Error. Overline badges mark modes (SPEC, AGI).
items.author: user

items.label: field.md
items.body: Filled, never outlined: 36px (32 compact) on --ds-field, label 12/16 above and a caption below. An invalid field fills danger-soft and the caption says how to fix it.
items.author: user

items.label: card.md
items.body: Cards are surface tone at 16px radius and 16px padding; a floating card moves to raised and takes the md shadow.
items.author: user

items.label: tabs.md
items.body: HeaderTab is the window's tab: 28px, 208px wide, active fill and 500 weight, close on hover. Tabs is the in-page segmented control.
items.author: user

items.label: menu.md
items.body: Raised, 12px radius, 6px padding, items 30px with 8px insets; groups part by 6px of space and a caption label. Selected items carry a trailing check, destructive items go last in danger.
items.author: user

items.label: dialog.md
items.body: Dialogs are raised at 24px radius with 24px padding: confirm 440, form 560, content 720. Actions sit bottom right, primary last.
items.author: user

items.label: toast.md
items.body: Raised, 356px, colour only in the 16px icon. The title states the result; the description says why or what next.
items.author: user

items.label: sidebar.md
items.body: Sidebar parts from Sidebar.tsx: BrandMark at 13px with ghost search and filter, nav Rows (New chat, Pull requests, Projects, Automations), WorkspaceRow, SidebarHeading folds and SessionRow. The session row's slot shows the spinner while working and a StatusGlyph otherwise; hover swaps the harness mark for the … menu.
items.author: user

items.label: tool-lines.md
items.body: ToolLine is verb + target + optional source, body 13/18: the verb secondary, the directory at half muted, the file name muted, rising to primary on hover. While live, the -ing verb shimmers at 500. Bodies (ToolCallCard, CommandCard) open 6px below, indented 20px, in a ToolPanel at half elevated with 12px mono. ThinkingLine, WorkingIndicator, FileChips and WorkedGroup complete the turn.
items.author: user

items.label: diffs.md
items.body: DiffGroup sums a turn's edits; each DiffCard shows the verb, the path in caption, and ChangeCount in the diff colours, and previews 14 lines in a ToolPanel with a +N more footer.
items.author: user

items.label: composer.md
items.body: The composer is a 16px elevated field: the + at bottom-left, the 32px send at bottom-right (ArrowUp, Stop while running, spinner while starting). Under it: the autonomy chip (rounded-full, caption), then the model and reasoning chips on the right. Home layout gives the draft 112px with the controls beneath.
items.author: user
